ai.seo_question: What does it mean that prayer has four thousand gates?
ai.summary: In *Al-Khisal*, Shaykh al-Saduq records Imam al-Rida (peace be upon him) revealing that prayer comprises four thousand 'gates,' a metaphor for its comprehensive nature encompassing both outward legal rulings (*ahkam*) and inward spiritual stations (*maqamat*). This tradition underscores the Shia emphasis on prayer as a holistic act of worship that integrates jurisprudence with deep contemplation and divine proximity.
